name: Computer Aided Analysis for Automotive Electronics
description: Basic coding and mathematical operations in MATLAB; plotting and handling data; modelling converters and motors; controller design basics, including plant transfer functions; simulation of controlled systems in both continuous and discrete forms; SPICE simulation for converters and signal level analysis; modelling of converters and motors in simulink; study of HEV and EV models; electromagnetic component design focusing on high-frequency transformers and inductors; PCB design principles including routing rules and software features; EMI/EMC simulation fundamentals with LISN devices; and 3D modelling for fabrication using fusion360.
